name: Sumit Pande
title: Full Stack Engineer specializing in backend systems, distributed architecture, and scalable real-time applications using Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and React.

summary.title: About Me
summary.text: Full Stack Engineer with 3.8 years specializing in backend systems, distributed architecture, and internal platform engineering. Experienced in building scalable real-time applications, microservices, event-driven systems, and developer platforms using Node.js, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kafka. Strong expertise in system design, API architecture, schema modeling, authentication systems, and production-ready infrastructure. Known for owning greenfield products end-to-end — from architecture and schema design to deployment and optimization.

data.title: Software Engineering Specialist
description: Led end-to-end development of enterprise-grade internal platforms used across multiple teams, focusing on scalability, maintainability, and performance.
Built backend systems and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript, improving operational workflows and reducing manual effort through automation.
Designed and developed real-time and data-intensive features using distributed system principles and event-driven architecture.
Implemented AI-assisted tooling and workflow automation solutions to improve user productivity and platform usability.
Created reusable shared libraries and developer utilities adopted across multiple projects, improving development consistency and reducing duplication.
Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams on architecture design, code reviews, deployment workflows, and production support.

data.name: Nexus
description: Designed a horizontally scalable real-time messaging system supporting direct and group conversations using Redis Pub/Sub adapter for distributed WebSocket event fan-out.
Built a Notification Microservice consuming Kafka events and routing notifications to email and in-app channels with retry and dead-letter handling.
Implemented secure JWT authentication with HTTP-only refresh tokens, token rotation, reuse detection, and Redis-backed session management.
Modeled a normalized PostgreSQL schema with composite indexing and cursor-based pagination optimized for high-throughput message retrieval.
Architected the platform using Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Docker, and Socket.io following scalable microservice patterns.
